gpu_target: single RTX 4090, 24GB GDDR6X (RunPod/Vast — see README cost table)
rules: Licences are named exactly as verified in the two research files and the fetched repo files; buckets: open_source (named OSI licence) / free-but-restricted / paid / conflicted.

A byte size is present only where a source gives it; otherwise bytes=null and bytes_source says why (GAP) — sizes are measured and recorded by download_models.sh after download, never asserted in advance.

download_models.sh fetches ONLY disposition ship-clean* entries by default; the Turbo LoRA requires --fast-lane and prints its RECHECK flag; eval-only and refused entries are never downloaded by the script.
